proposed_tasks.name: 帮我排一下这些岗位先投哪些
proposed_tasks.scene: 职业方向探索与真实机会验证
proposed_tasks.business_goal: 我想根据已经找到的真实岗位清单，结合我的情况和偏好，排出先联系、后联系和暂缓的顺序，并说明为什么这样排。
user_request_examples: 帮我把这些岗位排一下，先投哪些、后投哪些。
这些机会里哪些最值得我优先去投？
结合我的情况，帮我排出联系这些岗位的先后顺序。
proposed_tasks.decision_reason: 需要把机会清单、个人画像和匹配分析综合成有取舍的先后排序并解释理由，属于非平凡的决策支持。

inputs.name: verified_opportunity_list
inputs.description: 已核验的真实岗位机会清单，作为待排序的候选机会

inputs.name: user_profile
inputs.description: 用户画像中的证据、偏好与现实约束，用于判断各岗位的贴合度与优先级

inputs.name: ranking_preferences
inputs.description: 用户关心的排序因素，如地理位置、组织类型、机会类型、时间紧迫性和准备成本

inputs.name: evidence_gap_analysis
inputs.description: 已有经历与目标方向要求的对照结果，作为排序时的匹配度补充参考；没有时忽略

outputs.name: opportunity_pursuit_ranking
outputs.description: 排序后的机会列表，每项给出建议顺序、排序理由、与用户证据的匹配点、不确定性和需要先核实的事项

proposed_tasks.name: 投这些岗位时重点突出什么、需要补什么
proposed_tasks.scene: 职业方向探索与真实机会验证
proposed_tasks.business_goal: 我想在投递或展示自己之前，知道针对这些方向应该重点呈现哪些已有经历、回避或弥补哪些短板，让材料更有针对性。
user_request_examples: 帮我把经历整理成适合投这些岗位的重点说明。
投这个方向时，我该突出哪些东西、弱化哪些？
针对我要投的方向，帮我列一份材料准备要点。
proposed_tasks.decision_reason: 需要把逐项匹配结果改写成面向投递的表达策略，包括突出点、弱化点和待补充证据，属于个性化内容决策。

inputs.name: evidence_gap_analysis
inputs.description: 已有经历与目标方向要求的逐项对照结果，作为生成投递重点的基础

inputs.name: target_direction
inputs.description: 要准备投递或展示的目标方向或岗位类型

inputs.name: user_profile
inputs.description: 用户画像中的已有证据与偏好，用于确认哪些经历可以如实突出

outputs.name: application_focus_brief
outputs.description: 针对目标方向的材料重点，包括建议突出的经历、建议弱化或避免的表达、待补充证据和不确定性说明

proposed_tasks.name: 帮我写联系从业者约聊的开口消息
proposed_tasks.scene: 职业方向探索与真实机会验证
proposed_tasks.business_goal: 我想基于准备好的访谈目标，写出适合不同场合的短消息，礼貌地约相关从业者交流，并让对方愿意回复。
user_request_examples: 帮我写一条约人聊天的私信，不要太正式。
我要在求职平台联系一位从业者，帮我写个开场消息。
帮我把访谈目标改写成不同版本的约聊话术。
proposed_tasks.decision_reason: 需要把访谈目标、个人背景和场合要求转化成多版得体、有针对性的开口消息，属于个性化文案生成与判断。

inputs.name: interview_prep_kit
inputs.description: 已生成的信息访谈目标与提问重点，作为消息内容的基础

inputs.name: outreach_context
inputs.description: 联系场合、平台类型、与对方的关系以及希望的语气

inputs.name: user_profile
inputs.description: 用户画像中的已有背景与约束，用于写出真实可信的自我介绍

outputs.name: outreach_message_drafts
outputs.description: 多版联系消息草稿，每版说明适用场合、语气特点、希望对方回应的点和注意事项

proposed_tasks.name: 预判申请这些方向时可能被问到的问题
proposed_tasks.scene: 职业方向探索与真实机会验证
proposed_tasks.business_goal: 我想在投递和沟通前，先知道这个方向的人通常会被考察什么、我的回答重点怎么准备，减少临场没把握的情况。
user_request_examples: 投这个方向一般会被问哪些问题？
根据我的经历和岗位要求，帮我想想对方可能会考察我什么。
帮我预判一下申请这些机会时最可能被问的问题和回答要点。
proposed_tasks.decision_reason: 需要结合个人证据缺口和该方向的常见要求，推断最可能被考察的点并组织回答思路，属于非平凡的个性化预判。

retained_tasks.name: 探索可能适合我的职业方向
retained_tasks.scene: 职业方向探索与真实机会验证
retained_tasks.business_goal: 我想先看清有哪些职业方向可能适合我，每个方向实际做什么、和我的已有经历及偏好是否呼应，而不是只看岗位名称猜测。
user_request_examples: 我还没想好往哪个方向发展，帮我看看有哪些可以考虑的方向。
根据我的经历和偏好，帮我列出几个值得了解的职业方向。
我想从每天实际做什么的角度，看看有哪些方向可能适合我。
retained_tasks.decision_reason: 需要综合用户画像中的证据、偏好与约束，生成带理由、来源和不确定性的方向候选，属于非平凡的决策支持能力。

inputs.name: user_profile
inputs.description: 用户画像中的事实、证据、偏好与现实约束，作为生成候选方向的个体依据

inputs.name: exploration_domains
inputs.description: 用户希望聚焦的领域或行业列表；为空表示跨领域探索

inputs.name: direction_count
inputs.description: 希望返回的方向数量上限

inputs.name: constraints
inputs.description: 影响方向取舍的现实约束，如每周可投入时间、地域偏好和计划期限

outputs.name: direction_exploration_report
outputs.description: 候选方向清单，逐项说明实际工作内容、典型交付、协作对象、与用户证据的关联和不确定性

retained_tasks.name: 了解一个方向的实际日常工作
retained_tasks.scene: 职业方向探索与真实机会验证
retained_tasks.business_goal: 想具体了解某个方向的人在真实工作中处理什么问题、交付什么成果、和谁协作，以便判断我是否真的想做。
user_request_examples: 帮我看看做这个方向的人每天到底在做什么。
这个岗位实际要交付什么成果，平时和哪些人配合？
帮我找几个真实案例，说明这个方向的日常工作是什么样的。
retained_tasks.decision_reason: 需要从多来源原始信息中提炼真实工作活动、交付物和协作关系，并标注证据来源与不确定性，不是简单检索。

inputs.name: target_direction
inputs.description: 用户要了解工作内容的具体方向或岗位类型

inputs.name: work_context
inputs.description: 用户指定的行业、组织类型或地区等背景，用于限定工作内容描述

inputs.name: real_work_search_results
inputs.description: 公开来源中关于该方向日常工作、项目和交付物的检索结果，用于提炼真实工作活动

inputs.name: real_work_page_extracts
inputs.description: 从检索结果中筛选出的原文页面内容，用于提炼真实工作活动

outputs.name: real_work_profile
outputs.description: 目标方向的实际任务、交付物、协作对象、典型节奏、来源链接和不确定性

retained_tasks.name: 了解目标方向的进入要求和成长路径
retained_tasks.scene: 职业方向探索与真实机会验证
retained_tasks.business_goal: 想弄清进入这个方向需要哪些条件、通常有哪几条路径，以及不同阶段需要积累什么。
user_request_examples: 进入这个方向一般需要什么背景和技能？
这个方向从初级到资深通常怎么发展，门槛在哪里？
帮我了解目标地区对这个方向岗位的常见要求。
retained_tasks.decision_reason: 需要把多来源招聘和从业者信息整理成进入条件、路径与阶段说明，并保留来源证据，属于有意义的信息综合。

inputs.name: target_direction
inputs.description: 要了解进入要求的目标方向或岗位类型

inputs.name: target_region
inputs.description: 用户关心的目标地区，用于限定地区差异

inputs.name: target_level
inputs.description: 用户关心的职级或经验阶段，如入门、初级、中级；为空则覆盖主要阶段

inputs.name: entry_search_results
inputs.description: 公开来源中关于该方向任职要求、招聘门槛和成长路径的检索结果

inputs.name: entry_page_extracts
inputs.description: 筛选后的原文页面内容，用于核对具体任职条件和路径

outputs.name: entry_requirements_report
outputs.description: 目标方向的任职条件、常见进入路径、层级阶段、地区差异、来源证据和不确定性

retained_tasks.name: 寻找符合我条件的真实岗位机会
retained_tasks.scene: 职业方向探索与真实机会验证
retained_tasks.business_goal: 帮我从公开、可核验的信息源找出符合我条件的真实岗位机会，并保留链接、发布时间、地点、组织和工作内容。
user_request_examples: 帮我寻找符合我条件的真实岗位机会。
按我的要求找一些真实在招的岗位，要给出来源链接。
帮我收集符合我目标地区和机会类型的岗位，并注明发布信息。
retained_tasks.decision_reason: 需要按用户条件筛选、去重、核对真实性与时效性，并输出结构化机会清单，超越普通搜索和抓取的原始输出。

inputs.name: opportunity_criteria
inputs.description: 用户对目标机会的要求，包括目标地区、机会类型、方向或领域、发布时间等

inputs.name: opportunity_search_results
inputs.description: 按用户条件检索到的公开岗位信息结果，用于找出候选机会

inputs.name: opportunity_detail_extracts
inputs.description: 岗位详情页原文，用于核对岗位状态、职责、组织与链接有效性

inputs.name: result_size_limit
inputs.description: 用户希望返回的岗位数量上限

outputs.name: verified_opportunity_list
outputs.description: 符合条件的机会列表，每项含组织、地点、发布时间、链接、工作内容概述和核验状态

retained_tasks.name: 核实岗位信息来源与有效性
retained_tasks.scene: 职业方向探索与真实机会验证
retained_tasks.business_goal: 想让我提供或找到的岗位链接和信息经过核实，确认来源真实、仍在有效期，并指出不确定的地方。
user_request_examples: 帮我核实这几个岗位链接是不是真实有效的。
这些招聘信息靠谱吗？帮我查一下来源和组织。
帮我确认这些机会是否还在招人。
retained_tasks.decision_reason: 需要对用户提供的链接逐项核查真实性、有效性和组织一致性，生成带不确定性的核验结论，属于独立决策。

inputs.name: opportunities_to_verify
inputs.description: 用户提供的待核实岗位清单，每项含标题、组织、链接等

inputs.name: verification_page_extracts
inputs.description: 从待核实链接取得的页面原文，用于检查链接有效性与内容一致性

inputs.name: verification_search_results
inputs.description: 针对组织和岗位名称的补充检索结果，用于交叉验证来源可信度

outputs.name: opportunity_verification_report
outputs.description: 逐项说明链接有效性、发布状态、组织与内容一致性、可疑信号和证据不足处

retained_tasks.name: 比较几个方向或岗位
retained_tasks.scene: 职业方向探索与真实机会验证
retained_tasks.business_goal: 把我提出的几个方向或岗位放到同一套维度下比较，说明差异、取舍和待验证的问题。
user_request_examples: 帮我把这几个方向放在一起比一比。
比较一下这两个岗位在日常工作、门槛和发展上的差异。
这些选项里哪些维度差别最大，我该怎么取舍？
retained_tasks.decision_reason: 需要把多个异构选项映射到统一维度并解释取舍，生成对比证据而非简单罗列，属于非平凡比较决策。

inputs.name: options_to_compare
inputs.description: 用户希望比较的方向或岗位列表，每项包含名称、描述、来源链接等

inputs.name: comparison_dimensions
inputs.description: 用户关心的比较维度，如工作内容、进入门槛、发展空间、与自身证据的匹配度等；为空时使用默认维度

inputs.name: user_profile
inputs.description: 用户画像中的证据与偏好，用于判断各选项与用户的契合度

outputs.name: option_comparison_report
outputs.description: 按用户选定维度展开的对比矩阵、关键取舍、待验证问题和对后续验证的提示

retained_tasks.name: 把我的经历与目标岗位要求对照
retained_tasks.scene: 职业方向探索与真实机会验证
retained_tasks.business_goal: 想把我已有的经历和证据与目标方向的要求逐项对照，找出匹配、差距和需要补的验证。
user_request_examples: 把我的经历和这个岗位的任职要求逐条对照一下。

input.system_prompt:
You are a SkillTool portfolio architect. Design reusable, standalone AI capabilities from a reference profile and a reference business scenario. These inputs may be free-form natural language; do not assume they follow a JSON schema. A SkillTool is a bounded business capability executed by a child model through an external API. It must not depend on an application implementation.

Rules:
1. Return strict JSON only. Never wrap JSON in Markdown. Never use ellipses (`...`), comments, pseudo-JSON, or placeholder literals; represent illustrative context as ordinary strings so the entire response parses with a standard JSON parser.
2. Preserve uncertainty and evidence provenance. Do not invent personal facts or live market facts.
3. Design a menu of independently invocable capabilities for a scenario, not a mandatory end-to-end workflow. Parallel capabilities are the default; composition is optional.
4. Build an explicit input inventory before designing capabilities. Reuse contracted upstream artifacts even when their producer was an ordinary tool and therefore was not synthesized as a SkillTool.
5. Every task input must use exactly one truthful provisioning class: user-provided input, an existing ordinary-tool output, an existing scenario artifact, or a prior task output. Every input and output declares a concrete JSON type.
6. Every output must have an explicit schema and at least one truthful consumer. The user or an external system is a valid consumer; never invent a downstream SkillTool merely to create a chain.
7. A SkillTool owns one meaningful business decision or transformation. Reject trivial formatting/retrieval wrappers and split multi-decision mega-skills. Tasks already handled by an ordinary tool remain visible as input producers but must not become SkillTools.
8. SkillTools are portable: no main-program imports, database assumptions, UI state, route names, or internal service calls.
9. Profile and scenario are strictly decoupled. The scenario defines the problem space. The profile only supplies personal evidence and constraints inside that space. Never infer a target industry, role, or scenario domain from education, major, projects, or skills.
10. If the scenario domain is open, keep exploration cross-domain or request an explicit domain; never silently default to the profile's background.
11. Auxiliary tools may only come from the supplied non-Skill tool catalog. Select none by default. Every selected tool needs a required, optional, or conditional usage mode and a concrete reason. Conditional tools need a condition; optional tools need a fallback.
12. Never select Skill, discover_skills, ReturnSkillResult, a generated SkillActionTool, or another recursive Skill entry as an auxiliary tool.
13. Use snake_case IDs and PascalCase tool names.
14. A standalone SkillTool must be runnable from provided inputs, upstream artifacts, user input, or ordinary tools. Prior SkillTool outputs may enrich it only as optional inputs.
15. Only an explicitly aggregate capability may require prior SkillTool outputs, and aggregate capabilities must remain a minority of the portfolio.

用户希望从实际工作活动出发探索可能的职业方向，了解真实岗位每天处理的问题、交付成果、协作对象和进入要求，将自身证据与岗位要求进行对照，缩小值得继续验证的方向，并制定可执行的验证行动。目标地区、目标行业、机会类型、方向数量、计划周期和每周可投入时间都应在调用时从用户处获取，不能在场景或任务中写死。

- Run the utterance test before returning each task: if its `name` and `business_goal` cannot naturally complete “我想请你……” or “帮我……”, rewrite, merge into a user-facing outcome, or remove it.
- `user_request_examples` is mandatory and must contain 2-4 distinct, realistic utterances without analyst jargon. It is evidence that the task passes the utterance test; do not merely paraphrase an abstract task label.
- For extension tasks, run the continuation test: every example must sound natural after “那接下来……”. Rewrite phrases such as “形成可验证假设”, “建立证据闭环”, or “输出置信度评估” into the concrete thing the user wants to compare, choose, check, prepare, or schedule.
- Prefer the smallest set that still satisfies the direction's explicit coverage and count rule. Never create analytical subtasks merely to increase the count. Keep inputs and outputs structured internally, but keep the task boundary and visible wording natural.

GENERALITY AND PARAMETERIZATION GATE:
- The scenario defines a reusable capability for many users. The reference profile is only one sample used to select relevant capabilities; none of its literal facts may become fixed task scope.
- Do not copy cities, regions, employers, schools, degrees, majors, technologies, personal projects, dates, numeric targets, time budgets, or other sample-user values into any task field, including input names and descriptions.
- Do not generalize a sample computer-science profile into “技术岗位”, “技术方向”, “算法”, “软件”, “开发”, or similar domain language. Use domain-neutral terms such as “目标岗位类型”, “目标方向”, and “用户指定领域”.
- Keep variable details as typed invocation inputs. Say “目标地区”, “用户指定的机会类型”, “希望保留的方向数量”, and “可用验证周期” rather than inserting sample values.
- A generic job-search task should be “帮我寻找符合我条件的真实岗位机会”, never “帮我寻找某几个具体城市的某类岗位”. A generic planning task must not hard-code a four-week duration or a fixed number of directions.
- Before returning, compare every user-visible task field against REFERENCE PROFILE and remove or parameterize any copied personal detail.

Follow TASK COUNT RULE exactly. In initialization, `coverage` must contain at least 8 distinct scenario outcomes and every proposed task ID must appear in at least one `covered_by` list. Every proposed task must predict at least one concrete output before it can be retained. Input descriptions and output `dedupe_key` values must describe stable semantics rather than wording so input, output, and task-description similarity can all be checked. Enforce the source/origin pairs exactly: user_input/user_provided, ordinary_tool_output/tool_generated, upstream_artifact/existing_artifact, prior_output/prior_task_output. User input may be inferred when it is reasonable to ask at invocation time. A tool-generated input must name an exact AVAILABLE ORDINARY TOOLS provider. An existing-artifact input must reference an asset_id from EXISTING SCENARIO ARTIFACTS. A prior-task-output input must reference TASK OUTPUT POOL and is forbidden in iteration 1. Every input and output must declare type; every output must use output_origin task_generated. Mark simple collection, CRUD, retrieval, and profile persistence tasks ordinary_tool or input_only; synthesize only non-trivial reusable decisions or transformations. Stay inside the reference scenario. Treat the task map as a user-facing capability menu, not an execution plan. A technical profile must not turn a generic scenario into a technology-specific scenario.

messages.content:
You are a SkillTool portfolio architect. Design reusable, standalone AI capabilities from a reference profile and a reference business scenario. These inputs may be free-form natural language; do not assume they follow a JSON schema. A SkillTool is a bounded business capability executed by a child model through an external API. It must not depend on an application implementation.

Rules:
1. Return strict JSON only. Never wrap JSON in Markdown. Never use ellipses (`...`), comments, pseudo-JSON, or placeholder literals; represent illustrative context as ordinary strings so the entire response parses with a standard JSON parser.
2. Preserve uncertainty and evidence provenance. Do not invent personal facts or live market facts.
3. Design a menu of independently invocable capabilities for a scenario, not a mandatory end-to-end workflow. Parallel capabilities are the default; composition is optional.
4. Build an explicit input inventory before designing capabilities. Reuse contracted upstream artifacts even when their producer was an ordinary tool and therefore was not synthesized as a SkillTool.
5. Every task input must use exactly one truthful provisioning class: user-provided input, an existing ordinary-tool output, an existing scenario artifact, or a prior task output. Every input and output declares a concrete JSON type.
6. Every output must have an explicit schema and at least one truthful consumer. The user or an external system is a valid consumer; never invent a downstream SkillTool merely to create a chain.
7. A SkillTool owns one meaningful business decision or transformation. Reject trivial formatting/retrieval wrappers and split multi-decision mega-skills. Tasks already handled by an ordinary tool remain visible as input producers but must not become SkillTools.
8. SkillTools are portable: no main-program imports, database assumptions, UI state, route names, or internal service calls.
9. Profile and scenario are strictly decoupled. The scenario defines the problem space. The profile only supplies personal evidence and constraints inside that space. Never infer a target industry, role, or scenario domain from education, major, projects, or skills.
10. If the scenario domain is open, keep exploration cross-domain or request an explicit domain; never silently default to the profile's background.
11. Auxiliary tools may only come from the supplied non-Skill tool catalog. Select none by default. Every selected tool needs a required, optional, or conditional usage mode and a concrete reason. Conditional tools need a condition; optional tools need a fallback.
12. Never select Skill, discover_skills, ReturnSkillResult, a generated SkillActionTool, or another recursive Skill entry as an auxiliary tool.
13. Use snake_case IDs and PascalCase tool names.
14. A standalone SkillTool must be runnable from provided inputs, upstream artifacts, user input, or ordinary tools. Prior SkillTool outputs may enrich it only as optional inputs.
15. Only an explicitly aggregate capability may require prior SkillTool outputs, and aggregate capabilities must remain a minority of the portfolio.

REFERENCE PROFILE (personal evidence and constraints only):
用户是一名计算机科学与技术硕士研究生，预计 12 至 18 个月后毕业，目前没有正式实习经历。求职地点优先考虑上海、杭州和深圳，每周可投入 8 至 12 小时进行方向探索。

已有证据包括：用 Python 和 PyTorch 完成课程及研究实验；独立完成过图像分类课程项目和校园知识库问答原型；能够检索论文、设计对比实验并撰写技术报告。尚无生产部署、多人协作、真实用户、业务指标或正式开发流程方面的可靠证据，商业问题理解能力也尚未验证。

用户喜欢分析复杂问题、做实验或设计方案，希望成果能被真实采用并获得明确反馈；不喜欢长期重复且缺少判断空间的工作。倾向先比较多个方向，再通过真实岗位、信息访谈、短期项目或实习投递验证。

画像只提供个人事实、证据、偏好和现实约束。不得因为计算机专业、Python、PyTorch 或问答原型，直接推断用户的目标行业、目标岗位或目标赛道。

REFERENCE SCENARIO (scope and boundary only):
本轮场景是“职业方向探索与真实机会验证”。这是一个面向不同自然用户的通用场景，不预设城市、学校、专业、技术栈、行业、岗位或毕业时间。

上一场景是“用户画像分析”，已经产生并由用户确认已有产物 `user_profile`（用户画像，object 类型）。本轮可以读取该产物中的事实、证据、偏好和现实约束，但不得重新生成或修改用户画像，也不得把某个样例用户的具体属性固化成通用任务名称、任务目标或示例问法。

用户希望从实际工作活动出发探索可能的职业方向，了解真实岗位每天处理的问题、交付成果、协作对象和进入要求，将自身证据与岗位要求进行对照，缩小值得继续验证的方向，并制定可执行的验证行动。目标地区、目标行业、机会类型、方向数量、计划周期和每周可投入时间都应在调用时从用户处获取，不能在场景或任务中写死。

岗位机会需要来自可核验的信息源，并保留链接、发布时间、地点、组织和工作内容。缺少真实反馈时，只能呈现证据、不确定性和待验证项，不能断言用户适合某个岗位。

任务输入只能来自四类：调用时向用户获取的输入、现有普通工具生成的输出、场景声明的已有产物、第二轮及以后已经存在的任务输出。每个输入和输出必须声明 object、array、string、number 或 boolean 类型。MCP 工具不在本场景范围内。

合成出的任务必须像普通用户会直接提出的一条完整请求。岗位检索应表达为“帮我寻找符合我条件的真实岗位机会”，而不是写成某几个城市的岗位采集；方向筛选和行动规划同样必须把数量、地点、期限等个人条件保留为调用参数。

- A task is a user-recognizable request, not an internal analysis step, ontology operation, or pipeline component.
- Start from what a normal user would ask for in one message. Use everyday service language such as “帮我看看我适合哪些方向”, “帮我比较这几个岗位”, or “我接下来四周先做什么”.

- Run the utterance test before returning each task: if its `name` and `business_goal` cannot naturally complete “我想请你……” or “帮我……”, rewrite, merge into a user-facing outcome, or remove it.
- `user_request_examples` is mandatory and must contain 2-4 distinct, realistic utterances without analyst jargon. It is evidence that the task passes the utterance test; do not merely paraphrase an abstract task label.
- For extension tasks, run the continuation test: every example must sound natural after “那接下来……”. Rewrite phrases such as “形成可验证假设”, “建立证据闭环”, or “输出置信度评估” into the concrete thing the user wants to compare, choose, check, prepare, or schedule.

input.system_prompt:
You are a SkillTool portfolio architect. Design reusable, standalone AI capabilities from a reference profile and a reference business scenario. These inputs may be free-form natural language; do not assume they follow a JSON schema. A SkillTool is a bounded business capability executed by a child model through an external API. It must not depend on an application implementation.

Rules:
1. Return strict JSON only. Never wrap JSON in Markdown. Never use ellipses (`...`), comments, pseudo-JSON, or placeholder literals; represent illustrative context as ordinary strings so the entire response parses with a standard JSON parser.
2. Preserve uncertainty and evidence provenance. Do not invent personal facts or live market facts.
3. Design a menu of independently invocable capabilities for a scenario, not a mandatory end-to-end workflow. Parallel capabilities are the default; composition is optional.
4. Build an explicit input inventory before designing capabilities. Reuse contracted upstream artifacts even when their producer was an ordinary tool and therefore was not synthesized as a SkillTool.
5. Every task input must use exactly one truthful provisioning class: user-provided input, an existing ordinary-tool output, an existing scenario artifact, or a prior task output. Every input and output declares a concrete JSON type.
6. Every output must have an explicit schema and at least one truthful consumer. The user or an external system is a valid consumer; never invent a downstream SkillTool merely to create a chain.
7. A SkillTool owns one meaningful business decision or transformation. Reject trivial formatting/retrieval wrappers and split multi-decision mega-skills. Tasks already handled by an ordinary tool remain visible as input producers but must not become SkillTools.
8. SkillTools are portable: no main-program imports, database assumptions, UI state, route names, or internal service calls.
9. Profile and scenario are strictly decoupled. The scenario defines the problem space. The profile only supplies personal evidence and constraints inside that space. Never infer a target industry, role, or scenario domain from education, major, projects, or skills.
10. If the scenario domain is open, keep exploration cross-domain or request an explicit domain; never silently default to the profile's background.
11. Auxiliary tools may only come from the supplied non-Skill tool catalog. Select none by default. Every selected tool needs a required, optional, or conditional usage mode and a concrete reason. Conditional tools need a condition; optional tools need a fallback.
12. Never select Skill, discover_skills, ReturnSkillResult, a generated SkillActionTool, or another recursive Skill entry as an auxiliary tool.
13. Use snake_case IDs and PascalCase tool names.
14. A standalone SkillTool must be runnable from provided inputs, upstream artifacts, user input, or ordinary tools. Prior SkillTool outputs may enrich it only as optional inputs.
15. Only an explicitly aggregate capability may require prior SkillTool outputs, and aggregate capabilities must remain a minority of the portfolio.
input.user_prompt:
Discover the next batch of modular tasks through iterative synthesis.

ITERATION: 2
ITERATION DIRECTION: extension

REFERENCE PROFILE (personal evidence and constraints only):
用户是一名计算机科学与技术硕士研究生，预计 12 至 18 个月后毕业，目前没有正式实习经历。求职地点优先考虑上海、杭州和深圳，每周可投入 8 至 12 小时进行方向探索。

已有证据包括：用 Python 和 PyTorch 完成课程及研究实验；独立完成过图像分类课程项目和校园知识库问答原型；能够检索论文、设计对比实验并撰写技术报告。尚无生产部署、多人协作、真实用户、业务指标或正式开发流程方面的可靠证据，商业问题理解能力也尚未验证。

用户喜欢分析复杂问题、做实验或设计方案，希望成果能被真实采用并获得明确反馈；不喜欢长期重复且缺少判断空间的工作。倾向先比较多个方向，再通过真实岗位、信息访谈、短期项目或实习投递验证。

画像只提供个人事实、证据、偏好和现实约束。不得因为计算机专业、Python、PyTorch 或问答原型，直接推断用户的目标行业、目标岗位或目标赛道。

REFERENCE SCENARIO (scope and boundary only):
本轮场景是“职业方向探索与真实机会验证”。这是一个面向不同自然用户的通用场景，不预设城市、学校、专业、技术栈、行业、岗位或毕业时间。

上一场景是“用户画像分析”，已经产生并由用户确认已有产物 `user_profile`（用户画像，object 类型）。本轮可以读取该产物中的事实、证据、偏好和现实约束，但不得重新生成或修改用户画像，也不得把某个样例用户的具体属性固化成通用任务名称、任务目标或示例问法。

用户希望从实际工作活动出发探索可能的职业方向，了解真实岗位每天处理的问题、交付成果、协作对象和进入要求，将自身证据与岗位要求进行对照，缩小值得继续验证的方向，并制定可执行的验证行动。目标地区、目标行业、机会类型、方向数量、计划周期和每周可投入时间都应在调用时从用户处获取，不能在场景或任务中写死。

岗位机会需要来自可核验的信息源，并保留链接、发布时间、地点、组织和工作内容。缺少真实反馈时，只能呈现证据、不确定性和待验证项，不能断言用户适合某个岗位。

任务输入只能来自四类：调用时向用户获取的输入、现有普通工具生成的输出、场景声明的已有产物、第二轮及以后已经存在的任务输出。每个输入和输出必须声明 object、array、string、number 或 boolean 类型。MCP 工具不在本场景范围内。

合成出的任务必须像普通用户会直接提出的一条完整请求。岗位检索应表达为“帮我寻找符合我条件的真实岗位机会”，而不是写成某几个城市的岗位采集；方向筛选和行动规划同样必须把数量、地点、期限等个人条件保留为调用参数。

- A task is a user-recognizable request, not an internal analysis step, ontology operation, or pipeline component.
- Start from what a normal user would ask for in one message. Use everyday service language such as “帮我看看我适合哪些方向”, “帮我比较这几个岗位”, or “我接下来四周先做什么”.
- Do not expose abstract implementation labels as tasks, including “映射”, “矩阵构建”, “假设生成”, “提取”, “模式分析”, “方向模式”, “建模”, “聚类”, “框架设计”, or “优先级计算”, unless that exact technical artifact is explicitly requested by the user. These may be internal workflow steps inside a broader user-facing task.
- Run the utterance test before returning each task: if its `name` and `business_goal` cannot naturally complete “我想请你……” or “帮我……”, rewrite, merge into a user-facing outcome, or remove it.
- `user_request_examples` is mandatory and must contain 2-4 distinct, realistic utterances without analyst jargon. It is evidence that the task passes the utterance test; do not merely paraphrase an abstract task label.
- For extension tasks, run the continuation test: every example must sound natural after “那接下来……”. Rewrite phrases such as “形成可验证假设”, “建立证据闭环”, or “输出置信度评估” into the concrete thing the user wants to compare, choose, check, prepare, or schedule.

GENERALITY AND PARAMETERIZATION GATE:

- Do not copy cities, regions, employers, schools, degrees, majors, technologies, personal projects, dates, numeric targets, time budgets, or other sample-user values into any task field, including input names and descriptions.

An existing-artifact input must reference an asset_id from EXISTING SCENARIO ARTIFACTS. A prior-task-output input must reference TASK OUTPUT POOL and is forbidden in iteration 1. Every input and output must declare type; every output must use output_origin task_generated. Mark simple collection, CRUD, retrieval, and profile persistence tasks ordinary_tool or input_only; synthesize only non-trivial reusable decisions or transformations. Stay inside the reference scenario. Treat the task map as a user-facing capability menu, not an execution plan. A technical profile must not turn a generic scenario into a technology-specific scenario.

messages.content:
You are a SkillTool portfolio architect. Design reusable, standalone AI capabilities from a reference profile and a reference business scenario. These inputs may be free-form natural language; do not assume they follow a JSON schema. A SkillTool is a bounded business capability executed by a child model through an external API. It must not depend on an application implementation.

Rules:
1. Return strict JSON only. Never wrap JSON in Markdown. Never use ellipses (`...`), comments, pseudo-JSON, or placeholder literals; represent illustrative context as ordinary strings so the entire response parses with a standard JSON parser.
2. Preserve uncertainty and evidence provenance. Do not invent personal facts or live market facts.
3. Design a menu of independently invocable capabilities for a scenario, not a mandatory end-to-end workflow. Parallel capabilities are the default; composition is optional.
4. Build an explicit input inventory before designing capabilities. Reuse contracted upstream artifacts even when their producer was an ordinary tool and therefore was not synthesized as a SkillTool.
5. Every task input must use exactly one truthful provisioning class: user-provided input, an existing ordinary-tool output, an existing scenario artifact, or a prior task output. Every input and output declares a concrete JSON type.
6. Every output must have an explicit schema and at least one truthful consumer. The user or an external system is a valid consumer; never invent a downstream SkillTool merely to create a chain.
7. A SkillTool owns one meaningful business decision or transformation. Reject trivial formatting/retrieval wrappers and split multi-decision mega-skills. Tasks already handled by an ordinary tool remain visible as input producers but must not become SkillTools.
8. SkillTools are portable: no main-program imports, database assumptions, UI state, route names, or internal service calls.
9. Profile and scenario are strictly decoupled. The scenario defines the problem space. The profile only supplies personal evidence and constraints inside that space. Never infer a target industry, role, or scenario domain from education, major, projects, or skills.
10. If the scenario domain is open, keep exploration cross-domain or request an explicit domain; never silently default to the profile's background.
11. Auxiliary tools may only come from the supplied non-Skill tool catalog. Select none by default. Every selected tool needs a required, optional, or conditional usage mode and a concrete reason. Conditional tools need a condition; optional tools need a fallback.
12. Never select Skill, discover_skills, ReturnSkillResult, a generated SkillActionTool, or another recursive Skill entry as an auxiliary tool.
13. Use snake_case IDs and PascalCase tool names.
14. A standalone SkillTool must be runnable from provided inputs, upstream artifacts, user input, or ordinary tools. Prior SkillTool outputs may enrich it only as optional inputs.
15. Only an explicitly aggregate capability may require prior SkillTool outputs, and aggregate capabilities must remain a minority of the portfolio.

Discover the next batch of modular tasks through iterative synthesis.

REFERENCE PROFILE (personal evidence and constraints only):
用户是一名计算机科学与技术硕士研究生，预计 12 至 18 个月后毕业，目前没有正式实习经历。求职地点优先考虑上海、杭州和深圳，每周可投入 8 至 12 小时进行方向探索。

已有证据包括：用 Python 和 PyTorch 完成课程及研究实验；独立完成过图像分类课程项目和校园知识库问答原型；能够检索论文、设计对比实验并撰写技术报告。尚无生产部署、多人协作、真实用户、业务指标或正式开发流程方面的可靠证据，商业问题理解能力也尚未验证。

用户喜欢分析复杂问题、做实验或设计方案，希望成果能被真实采用并获得明确反馈；不喜欢长期重复且缺少判断空间的工作。倾向先比较多个方向，再通过真实岗位、信息访谈、短期项目或实习投递验证。

画像只提供个人事实、证据、偏好和现实约束。不得因为计算机专业、Python、PyTorch 或问答原型，直接推断用户的目标行业、目标岗位或目标赛道。

REFERENCE SCENARIO (scope and boundary only):
本轮场景是“职业方向探索与真实机会验证”。这是一个面向不同自然用户的通用场景，不预设城市、学校、专业、技术栈、行业、岗位或毕业时间。

上一场景是“用户画像分析”，已经产生并由用户确认已有产物 `user_profile`（用户画像，object 类型）。本轮可以读取该产物中的事实、证据、偏好和现实约束，但不得重新生成或修改用户画像，也不得把某个样例用户的具体属性固化成通用任务名称、任务目标或示例问法。

用户希望从实际工作活动出发探索可能的职业方向，了解真实岗位每天处理的问题、交付成果、协作对象和进入要求，将自身证据与岗位要求进行对照，缩小值得继续验证的方向，并制定可执行的验证行动。目标地区、目标行业、机会类型、方向数量、计划周期和每周可投入时间都应在调用时从用户处获取，不能在场景或任务中写死。

岗位机会需要来自可核验的信息源，并保留链接、发布时间、地点、组织和工作内容。缺少真实反馈时，只能呈现证据、不确定性和待验证项，不能断言用户适合某个岗位。

任务输入只能来自四类：调用时向用户获取的输入、现有普通工具生成的输出、场景声明的已有产物、第二轮及以后已经存在的任务输出。每个输入和输出必须声明 object、array、string、number 或 boolean 类型。MCP 工具不在本场景范围内。

合成出的任务必须像普通用户会直接提出的一条完整请求。岗位检索应表达为“帮我寻找符合我条件的真实岗位机会”，而不是写成某几个城市的岗位采集；方向筛选和行动规划同样必须把数量、地点、期限等个人条件保留为调用参数。

tasks.name: 帮我排一下这些岗位先投哪些

tasks.business_goal: 我想根据已经找到的真实岗位清单，结合我的情况和偏好，排出先联系、后联系和暂缓的顺序，并说明为什么这样排。

这些机会里哪些最值得我优先去投？

tasks.decision_reason: 需要把机会清单、个人画像和匹配分析综合成有取舍的先后排序并解释理由，属于非平凡的决策支持。
